business_summary.text: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited is one of India's top three basmati rice producers and exporters, with a flagship AEROPLANE brand and diversified FMCG operations.

call_points.text: Management expects sustained growth driven by distribution expansion and brand strengthening
Current capacity utilization at ~61%, with plans for volume-led growth
Focus on achieving cost efficiencies and better fixed cost absorption
Strong demand from both domestic and international markets
Company reached 38 countries with 436 domestic and 53 international distributors.

timeline.summary: On May 15, 2026, Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited incorporated AEROPLANE FMCG PTE. LTD in Singapore as a 100% subsidiary to deal in rice and FMCG products, subscribing 500 shares of USD 1 face value each.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹694.68 Cr, net profit ₹19.96 Cr.
On May 27, 2026, Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,287.1 Cr and net profit of ₹103.3 Cr.
Aeroplane reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹664 Cr, up 55% YoY, and PAT of ₹37 Cr, up 128% YoY, with improved margins.
